question: Begum Hazrat Mahal, the wife of the Nawab of ______ led the uprising at Lucknow in May, 1857.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Awadh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Begum Hazrat Mahal had a leading role in the rebellion against the British East India Company during the Revolt of 1857.
 
• Begum Hazrat Mahal also called Begum of Awadh was the second wife of Nawab Wajid Ali Shah.
 
• Her real name was Muhammadi Khanum.
 
• Awadh was annexed by the British East India Company in 1856.
 
• Nawab Wajid Ali Shah, the last Nawab of Awadh was sent into exile to Calcutta.
 
• After her husband had been exiled to Calcutta and the Indian Rebellion broke out, she made her son, Prince Birjis Qadr, the Wali (ruler) of Awadh, with herself as regent during his minority.
 
• However, she was forced to abandon this role after a short reign.
 
• She finally found asylum in Nepal where she died in 1879.
